blocks.explanation:
Is series mein signs baari baari badalte hain (+, \(-\), +, \(-\)), is liye seedha \(T_k\) likhna mushkil hai.
Behtar tareeqa: terms ke jore (pairs) banayein: \((1^2 - 2^2) + (3^2 - 4^2) + \ldots\). Har jora ek odd square minus agla even square hai.
Plan: \(k\)th jora likhenge, saada karenge, \(n\) jore sigma se jama karenge aur check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(1^2 - 2^2 + 3^2 - 4^2 + \ldots + (2n - 1)^2 - (2n)^2\)
Humein find karna hai: series ka jama \(S\).
Tareeqa: \(n\) jore \((2k - 1)^2 - (2k)^2\) banayenge, saada karenge, phir \(\sum 1 = n\) aur \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\) lagayenge.

Jore ginein aur \(k\)th jora likhein
\[(1^2 - 2^2) + (3^2 - 4^2) + \cdots\]
\[k\text{th pair} = (2k - 1)^2 - (2k)^2\]
Kyun: Series \((2n)^2\) par khatam hoti hai, matlab \(2n\) terms hain, jo \(n\) jore banate hain. \(k\)th jore mein odd number \(2k - 1\) aur even number \(2k\) hai (\(k = 1\): 1 aur 2; \(k = 2\): 3 aur 4).
Dhyan dein: yahan \(n\) terms nahi, \(2n\) terms hain.

\(k\)th jore ko saada karein
\[(2k - 1)^2 - (2k)^2\]
\[= (4k^2 - 4k + 1) - 4k^2\]
\[= 1 - 4k\]
Kyun: Pehla square khola aur \((2k)^2 = 4k^2\) minus kiya; \(4k^2\) cancel ho gaya aur sirf linear term \(1 - 4k\) bacha. Doosra tareeqa: \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\), yahan \(a - b = -1\) aur \(a + b = 4k - 1\); jawab wahi.

\(n\) jore jama karein
\[S = \sum (1 - 4k) = n - 4 \cdot \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{2}\]
\[= n - 2n^2 - 2n\]
\[= -2n^2 - n = -n(2n + 1)\]
Kyun: \(\sum 1 = n\) aur \(4 \cdot \frac{n(n + 1)}{2} = 2n(n + 1)\). Khol kar \(n - 2n = -n\), to \(-2n^2 - n\). Phir \(-n\) common nikala. Jawab negative hai, jo theek hai kyunke har jore mein bara square minus ho raha hai.

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 1:\ 1 - 4 = -3 = -1(3) \;\checkmark\]
\[n = 2:\ 1 - 4 + 9 - 16 = -10\]
\[-2(5) = -10 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(n = 1\) (do terms) aur \(n = 2\) (chaar terms) par seedha jama formula se mil gaya. Is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.explanation:
Is series ke \(k\)th term ka numerator pehle \(k\) squares ka jama hai aur denominator \(k\) hai.
Sum of squares ka formula lagate hi numerator mein ek \(k\) aa jata hai jo denominator ke \(k\) se cancel ho jata hai, aur \(T_k\) ek simple quadratic ban jata hai.
Plan: \(T_k\) banao, kholo, sigma se jama, common factor nikalo, check.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{1^2}{1} + \frac{1^2 + 2^2}{2} + \frac{1^2 + 2^2 + 3^2}{3} + \ldots\) \(n\) terms tak
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\).
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

\(k\)th term \(T_k\) nikalein
\[T_k = \dfrac{1^2 + 2^2 + \cdots + k^2}{k}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{k} \cdot \dfrac{k(k + 1)(2k + 1)}{6}\]
\[= \dfrac{(k + 1)(2k + 1)}{6}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{6}(2k^2 + 3k + 1)\]
Kyun: Numerator par sum of squares ka formula lagaya. Us mein \(k\) multiply ho raha hai aur denominator mein \(k\) hai, dono cancel. Phir \((k + 1)(2k + 1) = 2k^2 + 3k + 1\).

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = \dfrac{1}{6}\left[2\sum k^2 + 3\sum k + \sum 1\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{6}\left[\dfrac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{3} + \dfrac{3n(n + 1)}{2} + n\right]\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{6}\) bahar rakha, sigma ko teen hisson mein tora: \(2 \cdot \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6} = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{3}\), \(3 \cdot \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), aur \(\sum 1 = n\).

\(\frac{n}{6}\) nikal kar saada karein
\[= \dfrac{1}{6} \cdot \dfrac{n}{6}\left[2(n + 1)(2n + 1) + 9(n + 1) + 6\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{36}(4n^2 + 6n + 2 + 9n + 9 + 6)\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{36}(4n^2 + 15n + 17)\]
Kyun: Bracket ke andar denominators 3 aur 2 hain, common 6, is liye \(\frac{n}{6}\) nikala: \(\frac{1}{3} \to 2\), \(\frac{3}{2} \to 9\), \(n \to 6\). Bahar wale \(\frac{1}{6}\) ke saath \(\frac{n}{36}\). Like terms: \(6n + 9n = 15n\), \(2 + 9 + 6 = 17\).
Dhyan dein: bahar wala \(\frac{1}{6}\) bhoolna aam ghalti hai.

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 1 + \dfrac{5}{2} = \dfrac{7}{2}\]
\[\dfrac{2}{36}(16 + 30 + 17) = \dfrac{126}{36} = \dfrac{7}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.
